description: Manage workspace seats (Team plan, owner key required). action='create' mints a new seat API key (returned once; optional label). action='revoke' revokes a seat by id. Useful for an orchestrator agent provisioning keys for its sub-agents.

action.description: Mint a new seat or revoke one

id.description: Seat id to revoke (required for action='revoke')

label.description: Optional label for the new seat (action='create')

name: mlz_manage_seats
